basic_info.description: Welcome to 177 Townsend #335! This light-filled and spacious 1BR, 1BA unit with a convenient den / office nook offers a comfortable living experience with upgraded light fixtures throughout. The kitchen is a chef's dream with an updated island, quartz countertops, stylish backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. Work comfortably from home in the cozy office nook. The bathroom features an updated vanity, mirrors, cabinetry, lighting, shower door, and hexagon tile. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry and one-car parking. The unit includes a storage locker conveniently located on the same level. Residents of 170 Off Third have access to a range of amenities including a clubhouse with a fireplace and lounge area, a fitness center, a movie theater, a pool, a hot tub, a BBQ patio, and a stunning panoramic view roof deck. Be at the center of it all, justa short distance to Safeway, Gus Market, Whole Foods, a variety of restaurants, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and public transportation options. Plus, easy freeway access makes commuting a breeze.
